name: app-factory
description: The app skills: nine tracks that build, describe and ship apps to the App Store, Google Play and Windows — profile and copy, store metadata and media, signing, release and price sync. Each track is opt-in per repo: `factory-setup` reads the repo and writes its own .claude/settings.json, so App Store skills never load in a website. For many repos at once there is a separate marketplace, RepoGuards, which this one does not require.

plugins.name: factory-setup
plugins.description: The one track that is on everywhere: it says when a repo looks like an app and no track is enabled in it — the failure that otherwise looks exactly like a skill deciding it was not relevant.

plugins.name: apple-track
plugins.description: Apple: App Store and direct macOS distribution — identity, signing, compliance, metadata, media, icons, ASO, localization, shipping.

plugins.name: android-track
plugins.description: Android and Google Play: running a debug build on a device, keystore and credentials, policy compliance, listing metadata, media, icons, shipping the AAB, and replying to reviews.

plugins.name: capacitor-track
plugins.description: Capacitor apps: the strings that live in JS and HTML, and the WebView traps that only show up on a device.

plugins.name: shared-track
plugins.description: Cross-surface: the app's profile as the single source of truth, the listing metadata written from it for both stores, price reconciliation across every place a price appears, the release orchestrator, the naming decision made once for every surface, and the copy pass every customer-facing text runs through.

plugins.name: design-track
plugins.description: Visual craft for any HTML interface — typography, colour, motion and spatial composition. Generic: a Capacitor app's UI is HTML and CSS as much as a website is.

plugins.name: web-track
plugins.description: Building a website and keeping it found: the page's structure and conversion architecture before any visual work, the Web Interface Guidelines audit of the result, and the search, indexing and funnel read on the live sites.

plugins.name: windows-track
plugins.description: Windows: a direct-download installer that updates itself — WinSparkle wired into the app, the installer signed with the same EdDSA key as Sparkle, and a Windows appcast of its own.

plugins.name: announce-track
plugins.description: Announcing a release or an article: drafts for Hacker News, Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky and dev.to/Medium, written from a source of truth and checked against each channel's mechanical rules; posted only when asked, one confirmed post at a time, in a browser the user is already signed in to — never signs in or creates accounts.
